title: Apprendre l'anglais avec l'actu
author: Choses à Savoir
description: Je m'appelle Ben, je vis à Londres et je vous propose d'apprendre l'anglais en utilisant l'actu ! Learn English With News.

extraits.titre: Thank you so much for great stories
extraits.texte: If you want to improve your english, one way (for me the best), meet Ben through short stories. At my level i have to listen many times since my work travel, but it’s a pleasure when finnaly… you understand all the story. Funny, dramatics… always original.…
Thank you Ben, you’re my new friend I meet every day for an English lesson 😘
